mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) has a negative linear relationship with S&P 500 20-day returns; a higher rate increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative forward returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 325.0 (current level) indicates persistent inflation, triggering negative returns as investors anticipate further monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 325.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and increasing) and CPIAUCSL is above 325.0, it indicates a strong economy with persistent inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate robust corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the Rank IC for the interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong economic growth and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1200.0, SPX produces negative 20-day returns, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1200.0 (current level) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production index (INDPRO) has a positive relationship with equity returns; a higher INDPRO indicates strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) is above 24000 and RSAFS is above 700000, it indicates strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the Rank IC for the interaction term (GDPC1 * RSAFS) is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 4.5% (current level is 4.4%) indicates a weakening labor market, triggering negative returns as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
